input: Hire a dog walker for the upcoming work trip

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing whether this is just walks or includes feeding, overnight stays, or other care determines what type of service to look for.
The dog's size, breed, age, or special needs (medication, aggression, anxiety) will heavily influence which walkers are suitable.
The trip dates define the exact service window and how urgently the booking needs to happen.
A budget ceiling determines whether to use a premium service, an app like Rover, or a personal recommendation.
Whether the user already has a walker in mind, has used an app before, or is starting from scratch changes the immediate first action.
Some owners prioritise a walker coming to the home vs. a boarding situation, which completely changes the type of hire.
Understanding what would make the user feel confident the dog is in good hands (references, meet-and-greet, GPS updates) shapes what to verify before booking.

gold.taskTitle: Hire a dog walker for upcoming work trip
gold.taskDescription: Find and book a reliable dog walker to care for the user's dog while they are away on a work trip.

questions.title: What care is needed beyond just daily walks?
questions.description: Clarify whether the dog walker also needs to handle feeding, administering medication, overnight stays, or any other responsibilities during the trip.

questions.title: What are your dog's size, age, or special needs?
questions.description: Identify breed, size, age, and any behavioural or medical factors that would affect which walkers are a good fit.

questions.title: What are the exact dates of your work trip?
questions.description: Pin down the start and end dates to define the booking window and establish how much lead time is available.

questions.title: What is your budget per day for this service?
questions.description: Establish a spending limit to narrow down appropriate platforms, services, or individual walkers.

questions.title: Do you prefer the walker to come to your home?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants in-home visits, a dog boarding arrangement at the walker's place, or is open to either.

questions.title: Have you used a dog-walking app or service before?
questions.description: Find out if the user already has an account on Rover, Wag, or a local service, or if they are starting the search from scratch.

questions.title: What would make you confident enough to confirm a booking?
questions.description: Identify what trust signals the user needs — such as reviews, a meet-and-greet, insurance, or real-time GPS updates — before they feel comfortable finalising a hire.
